summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Itau Unibanco Holding S.A., a Brazilian bank, reporting a material fact regarding the approval by its Board of Directors of a payment of Interest on Capital (IoC) for fiscal year 2026. The total gross amount is BRL 3.99 billion with income tax withholding of 17.5%. The gross amount per share is BRL 0.36188 for both ITUB3 and ITUB4, netting BRL 0.29855 per share. Payment is scheduled by August 31, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 18, 2026, with ex-rights date on June 19, 2026. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation.
